Bounds and interface counterexamples

This pinpoints the failure: the adaptive maximum needs information absent from a learned-variance summary. It does not prove that every adaptive method must retain an entire posterior distribution.

The experiment order is not a universal decision order

The covariance theorem compares a specified squared-loss target class. It is not Blackwell dominance. A channel can preserve a nonlinear property perfectly while learning nothing about the parameter’s mean. Likewise, adaptive policies can have identical coordinatewise learned variances but different value for a joint target, because their random posterior means are dependent across transcripts.

These are boundaries of the representation, not numerical defects.

7. What survived the comparison with other directions

The earlier ordinary estimator’s win remains intact. This construction does not reinterpret repeated computation as new evidence or overturn the preceding information lower bounds. It uses acquired evidence to price the next real experiment.

I also retained the complementary approaches and their failures:

Local reliability redesign: an exact role-swap identity made a useful design decision certifiable from two relevant sources. In the executed fixture, the ordinary decision-only method used 135 observations. Constructing the full cache first raised the total to 4,233. The ordinary method wins that acquisition comparison. 
Local-design derivation
Gaussian and reduced-order reuse: the proposed fixed-response-span mechanism reduced to ordinary Woodbury/Schur calculations. Primary pyMOR code already constructs retained residual estimators and applies coercivity and output-norm bounds. That direction did not support a new algorithmic advantage. 
pyMOR source
Response-cone certification: a separate proved result reduces worst posterior discrepancy over a finite nonnegative evidence cone to mixtures of at most two rays. It is useful foundational capital, with explicit construction and normalization requirements; it is not used as a free oracle by the present compiler. 
Response principle
Shared circuits: the preserved bounds include a conjecture-conditional obstruction under a stated preprocessed OuMv assumption. It concerns general shared circuits and does not contradict the read-once construction. It remains conditional.

Reliability uncertainty propagation and importance analysis are established machinery; the primary 
SCRAM theory documentation was read as part of the comparison. The governing Astra material and relevant representation work were also read at a pinned revision. Full literature coverage was unavailable, so I am not presenting the algebra or compiler as a verified priority claim.

8. Scientific status and preserved record

The strongest established consequence is:

A retained representation can compile an acquisition objective itself, so that useful interactions, optimal fixed batches, and short adaptive policies become computable from the complete current evidence without repeating global inference for each candidate.

The construction pays for its representation, observations, updates, hypothetical planning and numerical error. Its scope is explicit. Ordinary methods can adopt it and inherit the same capability.

The unresolved leverage is now sharper: a compact, constructible interface for long adaptive continuation, or a scientific application where the total acquisition-and-planning bill demonstrably beats the strongest equally equipped alternative. The covariance order explains what fixed experiments preserve; the channel counterexample explains why that alone does not settle adaptive continuation. The high-order interaction example prevents treating short-horizon optimality as the solution.
